visualCharacteristics.purpose: Grid of portrait category tiles with an uppercase label and an EXPLORE link below each image (4-up desktop, 2-up mobile)
visualCharacteristics.description: 4-up grid of portrait image tiles (2-up on mobile); uppercase category label and EXPLORE link centered below each image, black text; minimal spacing, no borders.

contentPattern.name: category tiles
contentPattern.structure: one row per card: cell 1 image (optional mobile crop second); cell 2 category label heading and EXPLORE link
contentPattern.blockContent: One row per card: cell 1 image; cell 2 category label (h4, e.g. DENIM) and EXPLORE link (inside h3). Preceded in section by default-content heading SELECTED COLLECTIONS.

usage: Use for category/collection navigation tiles, typically after a SELECTED COLLECTIONS default-content heading.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any image + label + link tile grid; whole tile is clickable.
